title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：marathon　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 marathon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the runner ① ran the marathon that no coach in the stadium would have recorded, and he said the running was the whole of the year. The ② marathon, meaning the race itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a marathon, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ marathon in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ marathon at the far gate, meaning the mile they kept for the children to cheer and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A marathon, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the runner said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the marathon was the whole of the matter, meaning the patience and not the race. The ⑥ marathon, meaning the patience and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; marathon, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a race and a patience. He said the patience is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ marathon had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ marathon of the whole thing, the runner wrote in April, was one stadium and three years of recording; marathon, he said, is either the mile at the far gate or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ marathon I remember is the race recorded in the programme, which closed in 1991 and is still recorded as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ marathon, my mother said in 1993, is the only race that improves by being recorded; every marathon, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like a race. She said the patience was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 马拉松赛跑；长跑（指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 马拉松赛跑；长跑（指那场马拉松本身，与号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：run the marathon 跑这场马拉松
D. n. 马拉松赛跑；长跑（指留给孩子们喊的那一程那一场）
E. n. 长跑之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的马拉松之事）
F. n. 马拉松赛跑；长跑（指秩序册里写到、被记载的的那一场）
G. n. 耐力、坚持（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 坚持（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: ran the marathon that no coach in the stadium would have recorded
The marathon, meaning the race itself and not the bib
the marathon at the far gate
the marathon was the whole of the matter
the marathon had become a line in a programme
The marathon of the whole thing
A marathon, my mother said in 1993

answers.why: run the marathon 意为“跑这场马拉松”，1984 年那位跑者把体育场里没有一位教练肯记载的一场马拉松做了一遍。
marathon 意为“马拉松赛跑；长跑”，指那场马拉松本身而不是号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记载。
marathon 意为“马拉松赛跑；长跑”，指体育场里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
marathon 意为“马拉松赛跑；长跑”，指最远那道检录口留给孩子们喊的那一程那一场，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
marathon 意为“耐力、坚持”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份耐力就是那件事的全部。
marathon 意为“坚持”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场马拉松，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
marathon 意为“马拉松赛跑；长跑”，指秩序册里写到、被记载的的那一场，到 1989 年这一场成了秩序册里的一行。
marathon 意为“长跑之事”，跑者四月写道，整件事的马拉松之事是一处体育场和三个年份的记载。
marathon 意为“马拉松赛跑；长跑”，我记得的是秩序册里记载过的那一场，1991 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一场。
marathon 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，马拉松是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的马拉松。
